params.name: Chilling-injury threshold

source.title: Tomato: Recommendations for Maintaining Postharvest Quality (Produce Fact Sheet)
source.publisher: UC Davis Postharvest Research and Extension Center; T.V. Suslow & M. Cantwell

params.conditions: Chilling sensitive below 10 degC if held >2 weeks, or at 5 degC for >6-8 days; injury is cumulative
params.limitations: Threshold is a published range edge.

params.name: Critical chilling exposure E_crit

source.title: Tomato: Recommendations for Maintaining Postharvest Quality (Produce Fact Sheet)
source.publisher: UC Davis Postharvest Research and Extension Center; T.V. Suslow & M. Cantwell

params.conditions: 5 degC for ~7 days causes injury
params.limitations: Converts duration figure into degree-hours assuming linear dose.
params.derivation: E_crit = (10 - 5) degC x 24 h x 7 d = 840 degC.h

params.name: Humidity penalty slope below recommended RH

source.title: ZERO ROT engineering assumption (no published source)
source.publisher: ZERO ROT team

params.conditions: Applied linearly per %RH below the published RH range.
params.limitations: Shape not fitted to data; anchor (range edge) is published, slope is assumed.
params.derivation: h(RH) = 1 + slope x (RH_low - RH) for RH < RH_low

params.name: Humidity penalty slope above recommended RH (rot / condensation)

source.title: ZERO ROT engineering assumption (no published source)
source.publisher: ZERO ROT team

params.conditions: Applied linearly per %RH above the published RH range.
params.derivation: h(RH) = 1 + slope x (RH - RH_high) for RH > RH_high

params.name: Chilling penalty strength

source.title: ZERO ROT engineering assumption (no published source)
source.publisher: ZERO ROT team

params.conditions: c = 1 + gamma x min(E / E_crit, 3), E = cumulative degree-hours below chilling threshold.
params.limitations: Penalty shape is assumed; real chilling injury often appears after transfer to warm conditions.

params.name: Weight-loss coefficient (transpiration)

source.title: ZERO ROT engineering assumption (no published source)
source.publisher: ZERO ROT team

params.conditions: dW/dt = kw x VPD(T, RH) x (1 - W)
params.limitations: Not from a measured transpiration coefficient; order of magnitude only.

params.name: Rot onset rate below Q_rot

source.title: ZERO ROT engineering assumption (no published source)
source.publisher: ZERO ROT team

params.conditions: dR/dt = r0 x max(0, (Q_rot - Q)/Q_rot) x (1 + 0.1 x max(0, RH - RH_high)) + heat and chilling terms
